hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_response.file_path // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; f=$(realpath -m -- "$f"); case "$f" in "$PWD"/backend/*.java) (cd backend && ./mvnw -q spotless:apply -DspotlessFiles="$f") ;; "$PWD"/frontend/*.ts|"$PWD"/frontend/*.vue|"$PWD"/frontend/*.css|"$PWD"/frontend/*.json|"$PWD"/frontend/*.md) (cd frontend && [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] && node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f") ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true
